author: hatch
description: Provides strategic guidance for adventure encounters based on enemy attributes
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores a history of your Adventure gold balance and level, keyed by your Discord user ID, to draw stats charts. It will respect data deletion requests.
install_msg: Thank you for installing AdventureHelper! Make sure you're running the latest version of adventure from https://github.com/hatchcanon/hatch-cogs. Use `[p]adventurehelper toggle` to enable/disable the helper in your server.
name: AdventureHelper
